items.title: Papers: Zubimendi may push to leave Arsenal
items.description: The top stories and transfer rumours from Friday's newspapers...

items.title: UEFA Champions League
items.description: Highlights from the opening round of matches in the UEFA Champions League group stage.

items.title: Late drama as Lens fight back to beat 10-man Slavia Prague
items.description: Lens score two goals in stoppage time as they come from behind twice to beat 10-man Slavia Prague at the Fortuna Arena.

items.title: Olise scores twice as Bayern thrash Bodo/Glimt
items.description: England captain Harry Kane scores his 55th Champions League goal and Michael Olise strikes twice as Bayern Munich begin their campaign by comfortably beating Bodo/Glimt.

items.title: Champions League new boys Como dominant Leipzig
items.description: Como made an impressive Champions League debut by defeating visitors RB Leipzig 4-1 in their opening league-phase outing at Stadio Giuseppe Sinigaglia.

items.title: Fenerbahce boss stuns club by quitting after Roma draw
items.description: Ismail Kartal resigns as Fenerbahce's head coach just minutes after the Turkish side's 1-1 draw with Roma in the Champions League.

items.title: Brown scores fine equaliser as Fenerbahce draw with Roma
items.description: Englishman Archie Brown scores as Fenerbahce begin their return to Champions League football by holding Roma to a draw.

items.title: Man United put four past Sabah on Champions League return
items.description: Manchester United recorded their biggest Champions League victory since 2020 as they swept Sabah FK aside at Old Trafford.

items.title: PSV & Shakhtar Donetsk open Champions League campaign with draw
items.description: PSV Eindhoven and Shakhtar Donetsk played out a 1-1 draw to open their Champions League campaign at Philips Stadion.

items.title: Fernandes finishes off brilliant move to double Man Utd lead
items.description: Manchester United captain Bruno Fernandes rounds off a brilliant team move to double his side's lead over Sabah at Old Trafford.

items.title: Chelsea and Real Madrid keen on Arsenal's Zubimendi - Friday's gossip
items.description: Martin Zubimendi may seek to leave Arsenal in January, Mauro Icardi open to Everton move while Toffees play down move for Anthony Martial.

items.title: Spurs and Richarlison in dispute over contract
items.description: Tottenham and their forward Richarlison are in dispute over the remaining nine months on his contract.
